newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks to open lower, buyers holding out.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks to open lower, buyers holding out.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open lower on Thursday, hurt by the release earlier of stronger-than-expected August housing starts, which should dampen buyer enthusiasm.

"Rate concerns just won't go away and there's no urgency for buyers to step in at the opening without waiting to see how the market is. The housing numbers have put pressure on the bond market," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist for Fahnestock & Co.
